# Learning with Toma

> Free printable worksheets for children aged 4–7, in English, Croatian, Serbian and Polish. Made for parents, preschool educators and school teachers.

Learning with Toma (in Croatian and Serbian: Učimo s Tomom; in Polish: Uczymy się z Tomą) is a free
website that makes printable learning worksheets for children in seconds. Pick an activity,
choose the language (English, Croatian, Serbian or Polish), adjust a few settings and press
Generate: every worksheet is new. Print it on A4 paper or save it as a PDF. There is no account,
sign-up or payment.

## Activities

- [Spelling](https://learningwithtoma.com/spelling): Practise spelling with picture prompts. Links pictures to words and builds early spelling.
- [Counting](https://learningwithtoma.com/counting): Count objects and write the number. Practises counting one by one and writing numbers.
- [Biggest and Smallest](https://learningwithtoma.com/biggest-smallest): Circle the biggest and smallest objects. Trains visual comparison and the words for size.
- [Continue the Sequence](https://learningwithtoma.com/sequence): Spot the pattern and continue it. Builds pattern spotting, the basis of early maths and logic.
- [Find the Intruder](https://learningwithtoma.com/intruder): Spot the pictures that don't fit the theme. Practises grouping, vocabulary and explaining choices.
- [Complete the Line](https://learningwithtoma.com/line): Trace the pattern and continue it to the edge. Strengthens pencil control for the shapes used in handwriting.
- [Match the Shadow](https://learningwithtoma.com/shadow): Connect each picture to its shadow. Trains visual discrimination and attention to shape.
- [Maze](https://learningwithtoma.com/maze): Find the way through the maze. Builds planning, focus and pencil control.
- [Where Is It?](https://learningwithtoma.com/where): Find the picture that matches the sentence. Teaches position words like on, under, next to and above.
- [Copy the Pattern](https://learningwithtoma.com/copy-pattern): Copy a line drawing onto a dot grid. Develops visual-spatial skills and careful pencil movements.
- [Trace the Letters](https://learningwithtoma.com/trace): Trace dotted letters and numbers, then write them alone. Builds pencil control and letter recognition.
- [Dot to Dot](https://learningwithtoma.com/dot-to-dot): Join the dots in order to reveal a picture. Practises number order and steady hand movements.

## In Croatian, Serbian and Polish

The whole site, worksheets included, is also in Croatian, Serbian (Latin script) and Polish, with its own addresses:

- [Učimo s Tomom](https://learningwithtoma.com/hr/): Besplatni radni listovi za ispis za djecu od 4 do 7 godina, na engleskom, hrvatskom, srpskom i poljskom. Za roditelje, odgojitelje i učitelje.
- [Učimo s Tomom](https://learningwithtoma.com/sr/): Besplatni radni listovi za štampu za decu od 4 do 7 godina, na engleskom, hrvatskom, srpskom i poljskom. Za roditelje, vaspitače i učitelje.
- [Uczymy się z Tomą](https://learningwithtoma.com/pl/): Darmowe karty pracy do druku dla dzieci w wieku 4–7 lat, po angielsku, chorwacku, serbsku i polsku. Dla rodziców oraz nauczycieli w przedszkolach i szkołach.
